What if your heart stopped for ten minutes?
It beats about a hundred thousand times a day.
Often it just quivers, out of rhythm.
Blood stops flowing. No more oxygen!
Your brain uses twenty percent of it.
About ten seconds: you pass out.
After four minutes, brain cells start dying.
Every minute without help, survival drops up to ten percent.
Push hard and fast. Two pushes a second!
Each push squeezes blood to your brain.
Then an AED zaps your chest.
The quivering stops. The rhythm resets!
With fast CPR, some survive even ten minutes.
So... would you know how to do CPR?
